jei.bsp_core.info.illyrium_crucible:
Multiblock, 3 x 3 x 3. Place the controller at the bottom front centre and follow the ghost blocks.

Bottom layer: 8 Illyrium Casing around the controller.
Middle layer: a Lava Pylon in each corner, an Item Hatch left and right, the Illyrium Core in the centre.
Top layer: a Lava Pylon in each corner, Illyrium Casing on the four sides.

Lower pylons (orange sockets) take lava. Upper pylons (yellow sockets) take RF.
jei.bsp_core.info.illyrium_refinery:
Multiblock. Place the controller at the bottom front centre and follow the ghost blocks.

Bottom layer: 7 Illyrium Casing around the controller with the Illyrium Core in the centre.
Middle layer: Illyrium Tank Glass in the centre, Illyrium Casing behind it, Item Hatch on the left, Refinery Pump on the right.
Top: one more Illyrium Tank Glass.

The pump takes water (blue socket) and RF (yellow socket).
jei.bsp_core.info.shared_parts: A part of the Illyrium Crucible and the Illyrium Refinery. Place a controller to see ghost blocks showing where each part goes.
jei.bsp_core.info.factory:
One factory slice is 1 wide, 2 high and 3 long.

Bottom row from the front: Controller, Factory Frame, Blank Hatch.
Top row from the front: Factory Frame, Factory Press, Power Port.

Build slices side by side, facing the same way, to join up to 10 into one machine. Blanks go in the Blank Hatch, RF in the Power Port. Coins are taken from the tray by hand.
jei.bsp_core.info.motivator: Place on top of a complete factory slice, up to three per slice. One, two or three shorten that slice's press time by 15%, 30% or 50%.
jei.bsp_core.info.totem: You are given one Shatter Totem the first time you join. It cannot be crafted. Other players can steal it.
jei.bsp_core.info.plate: Pressed in the Combination Forge: one Tetrium Ingot makes one Tetrium Plate.

jei.bsp_core.info.decoy: A fake totem. Stand it on a Decoy Power Base fed with RF. Rival Totem Compasses within its range point at it, and everyone but you sees an ordinary Shatter Totem. An enemy who tries to steal it sets off its traps and breaks it. You may have five placed.
jei.bsp_core.info.decoy_base: The block a Decoy Totem must stand on. Feed it RF from the sides or below; the decoy draws 100 RF per tick.
jei.bsp_core.info.projector: Stands on a Projector Base and receives the powers a Plasma Interface offers through it, recreating them as a second aura. Needs 100 mB/t of Wave Plasma arriving. Right-click it to choose what it receives, pick chunks to load, and see its pressure.
jei.bsp_core.info.cable: Carries Wave Plasma from a Plasma Interface to Projectors at full pressure for its whole run: Tetrium Core 15 blocks, Magnatite Core 25, Illyrium Core 40, Charged Illyrium Core 80. A Plasma Repeater starts a fresh run. Each kind also has a limit on what it carries: 250 mB/t for Tetrium, 500 for Magnatite, 1,000 for Illyrium and Charged Illyrium; a run is held to its weakest cable. Magnatite, Illyrium and Charged Illyrium cables can be dyed (eight round a dye): a coloured cable joins only its own colour and a plain one only plain ones, so runs can be kept apart. The wrench sets each end: Normal, Output, Input, Off, or Linked to another colour.

jei.bsp_core.info.extractor: Place it directly under a placed Shatter Totem; more can stack below. It draws the totem's Wave Plasma out, split evenly between the stack. Any open face takes a Plasma Interface.
jei.bsp_core.info.interface: Hold Shift over any plasma block in JEI to see the whole hook-up built step by step. Touch it to a Plasma Extractor and plug Plasma Cables into it. Touching interfaces join into one, up to twelve blocks; more than that, or one touching an extractor another interface already serves, shows a lit seam and does nothing.
jei.bsp_core.info.repeater: Put it in a cable run to start a fresh run. Plasma goes in through its dark back and out through its lit front; placed pointing the way you look, right-click with an empty hand turns it round. It passes most of the pressure, and a projector behind it receives one power at full level or several each a level lower per repeater.
jei.bsp_core.info.expander: Right-click a Projector with it: the projector then receives three powers at once instead of two.

jei.bsp_core.info.charger: Placed with its open front toward you; the cable plugs into its back (the wrench turns it). Put a Plasma Battery or Power Cell in the slot. It fills the item with Wave Plasma and stamps powers the interface offers into it, chosen on its screen.
jei.bsp_core.info.battery: A tank of Wave Plasma that also holds stamped Base powers. Charge it in a Battery Charger, then stand it on a Plasma Extractor instead of a totem: it feeds the extractor at 100 mB/t with its powers until it runs dry. Higher tiers hold more plasma and more powers.
jei.bsp_core.info.cell: A small store of Wave Plasma with stamped Carried powers, charged in a Battery Charger. The Wave Emitter runs on it.
jei.bsp_core.info.charged_crystal: A Resonance Crystal magnetised in the Magnetic Centrifuge with a Magnatite Nugget. Every Plasma Battery and Power Cell is built around one.

Right-click at the air to open its screen: fit the cell, switch it on, see its powers and how long it will last. It draws 20 mB/t while on.

tooltip.bsp_core.wrench: Right-click a block to turn it: repeaters, valves, totems, batteries, machines. On a cable it sets the end you point at.
tooltip.bsp_core.wrench.sneak: Sneak + right-click turns it the other way (a repeater turns round)
jei.bsp_core.info.wrench: Turns blocks in place without picking them up: a Plasma Repeater steps through its six directions (sneak to turn it round), a totem or machine turns a quarter, a battery swaps its axis.
gui.bsp_core.tree.auras.label: AURAS
jei.bsp_core.info.projector_base: Plasma Cables plug into its four sides and it holds what arrives. Stand a Projector on it: the projector draws from the base. Cables do not join a projector directly.
gui.bsp_core.interface.legend.refused: Red: not part of the group
gui.bsp_core.valve.hint_redstone: A lever on the valve or a redstone signal shuts it. Drag the dial or type a number.
gui.bsp_core.valve.hint_free: Redstone is ignored: only the limit sets the flow. Drag the dial or type a number.
jei.bsp_core.info.valve: Put it in a cable run to limit what passes it, in mB/t, from its screen. A lever on it or a redstone signal shuts it, unless redstone control is switched off on the screen. Powers pass unchanged; it counts as one cable of reach and does not start a fresh run. The wrench turns its axis.
gui.bsp_core.emitter.hint_cell: Put a Power Cell in the slot.
gui.bsp_core.emitter.hint_offhand: The emitter works in your offhand.
gui.bsp_core.interface.help: Drag to turn, right-drag to pan, scroll to zoom. Numbers are mB/t passing each block this second. A cable with a dash carries nothing: out of reach, or nothing at its end.
guide.bsp_core.plasma.title: Wave Plasma hook-up
guide.bsp_core.plasma.tip.0: The extractor draws plasma from the totem that stands on it. More extractors stacked below share the flow between them.
guide.bsp_core.plasma.step.1: Place your Shatter Totem on top
guide.bsp_core.plasma.tip.1: A placed totem gives 100 mB/t, up to 6,000 with the ten levels of the Output upgrade. Cloaking takes 50 of it while on.
guide.bsp_core.plasma.step.2: A Plasma Interface touching the extractor
guide.bsp_core.plasma.tip.2: Interfaces that touch join into one group of up to twelve. Cables plug into any outer face, and each face sends up to 1,000 mB/t, so a big totem needs a big group. Right-click it for the flow view.
guide.bsp_core.plasma.tip.3: A run carries its full pressure to the end. Tetrium reaches 15 blocks and carries 250 mB/t, Magnatite 25 and 500, Illyrium 40 and 1,000, Charged Illyrium 80 and 1,000.
guide.bsp_core.plasma.step.4: A Plasma Valve in the run (optional)
guide.bsp_core.plasma.tip.4: Limits what passes it from its screen. A lever on it or a redstone signal shuts it. Powers pass unchanged.
guide.bsp_core.plasma.tip.5: Starts a fresh run, plasma in through its dark back and out through its lit front. Costs a tenth of the pressure; the wrench turns it.
guide.bsp_core.plasma.step.6: A Projector Base at the end
guide.bsp_core.plasma.tip.6: Holds 5,000 mB. It needs 100 mB/t arriving to run a projector and burns 20 mB/t, so it keeps going for a while after a cut.
guide.bsp_core.plasma.tip.7: Right-click it to choose the powers it receives. It runs on the plasma in its base: 100 mB/t arriving and it projects.
guide.bsp_core.plasma.tip.8: The interface shares its plasma equally between the runs leaving it. A run that needs less leaves the rest to the others.
guide.bsp_core.plasma.step.9: A Battery Charger, cable into its back
guide.bsp_core.plasma.tip.9: Fills the battery or cell standing in it and stamps powers into it. It only takes a cable at its back; place it facing you.

gui.bsp_core.wrench.hint.link: Right-click: link it to the other colour
tooltip.bsp_core.cable.ends: Keeps its wrench-set ends when placed
gui.bsp_core.tank.title: Plasma Tank
gui.bsp_core.tank.help: Drag to turn, right-drag to pan, scroll to zoom. Ports are labelled with their setting and what passes; the cables shown are the first three out of each port, not the whole network.
gui.bsp_core.tank.unformed.help: Build a hollow box of 3 to 12 blocks a side: Tank Casing on every edge, Tank Glass, Tank Casing or Tank Ports on the faces, nothing inside. It forms by itself when the last block goes in.
gui.bsp_core.tank.port.hint: Right-click: next setting. Sneak + right-click: previous.
jei.bsp_core.info.tank: A hollow box of 3 to 12 blocks a side: Tank Casing on every edge, Tank Glass, Tank Casing or Tank Ports on the faces, nothing inside. It forms by itself and holds 5,000,000 mB of Wave Plasma per block of the shell, no powers. Ports take plasma from a run that comes from an interface and give it to runs that only lead to bases, chargers or other tanks; the wrench sets a port to Input or Output only. Right-click any block for the tank's screen. Break one block and the plasma waits for it to come back.
jei.bsp_core.info.tetrium_glass: Glass strengthened with Tetrium: the ingredient for Tank Glass.
